item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q003_actin_like_atpase_divergence","answer":"In the current SCOPe 2.08 base release, the catalytic domains are separate families within the same Actin-like ATPase domain superfamily, c.55.1 (SUNID 53067): Actin/HSP70 is c.55.1.1 (SUNID 53068), hexokinase is c.55.1.3 (SUNID 53083), and glycerol kinase is c.55.1.4 (SUNID 53089). All also share fold c.55, the Ribonuclease H-like motif, in the alpha-and-beta class, but the superfamily placement—not merely the shared fold—is what SCOPe marks as implying homology. Thus their catalytic-domain cores are inferred to have a remote common evolutionary origin despite extensive sequence and functional divergence. This supports remote-homology reasoning and cautious use of one structure as a coarse domain-fold template for another; it does not justify assigning them to one family or transferring substrate specificity, reaction, regulation, cellular role, oligomeric state, full-chain architecture, or detailed active-site annotations. Functional transfer requires independent sequence/motif, ligand-binding, and preferably biochemical evidence. Template or representative choice must also account for domain boundaries, coverage, conformational and ligand state, and family-specific insertions; no single representative from one of these families is automatically suitable for the others.","evidence_used":["/api/v1/","/api/v1/openapi.yaml","/api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=Actin%2FHSP70&limit=100","/api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=hexokinase&limit=100","/api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=glycerol%20kinase&limit=100","/api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=Actin%2FHSP70&limit=20","/api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=hexokinase&limit=20","/api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=glycerol%20kinase&limit=20","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/c.55.1","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/c.55.1.1","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/c.55.1.3","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/c.55.1.4","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/53067/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/53066","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/53068","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/53083","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/53089"]}]}
